name: Dissolving potassium nitrate in water

time_constant_s.source: teaching-pace timescale, not a measured rate

observations.started: The white crystals begin to dissolve.
observations.saturated: No more potassium nitrate dissolves: the solution is saturated and crystals remain at the bottom.
observations.completed: All the potassium nitrate has dissolved. The solution stays colourless.

explanation: Water molecules pull the potassium and nitrate ions out of the crystal and spread them through the liquid.
